headline: Contracting workflows become measurable AI tasks
focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
summary: A collaboration with Ironclad translated representative contracting work into structured training and evaluation tasks. OpenAI reported that GPT-6 Astra achieved a higher average score and lower estimated time per attempt than GPT-5.6 Sol on the research task set.
why_it_matters: Professional AI needs to preserve business requirements across a complete workflow. Explicit task criteria make it possible to measure whether a finished process actually satisfies those requirements.
related_coverage: The Atlassian story covers enterprise context; this story covers measurable workflow execution.
image_alt_intent: State-machine diagram showing intake, rules, approvals, exceptions, agreement assembly, and verification.
